description: Somos un grupo conformado por estudiantes de Ingeniería Industrial, interesados en integrar a nuestro equipo personas creativas, proactivas y comprometidas, que tengan iniciativa para proponer ideas innovadoras y encontrar diferentes soluciones para el problema en cuestión.
summary: Our application aims to support farmers through personalized agricultural knowledge using NASA data and innovative technology, helping them make informed decisions about crop production, adapt to climate change, and promote a more sustainable and resilient future for agriculture. It addresses challenges such as soil nutrient loss, repetitive sowing of the same crops, changing weather conditions, lack of information when choosing what to plant, and limited internet access in rural areas. The application allows farmers to register basic information about one or more plots, consult environmental indicators for their location and selected period, save crop history, and compare the requirements of different crops with the recorded conditions. Based on this information, the system suggests suitable crops, evaluates planting and crop rotation strategies, and presents the best alternative, allowing users to save or download the results. All the information is displayed in a simple, clear, and easy-to-understand format so farmers can interpret the data and make better agricultural decisions.
details:
AGRO-ROTA is a global SaaS-based agricultural decision support system, designed to empower farmers and commercial producers with real-time satellite information hyperlocalized weather tracking through NASA POWER and sustainable crop rotation strategies adapted to 7 main global agroecological zones. The project seeks to optimize agricultural production, improve the use of natural resources, reduce the risks associated with climatic conditions and promote sustainable agricultural practices. Its expected impact is to benefit both small farmers and commercial producers, facilitating access to technological information that contributes to more efficient, resilient and environmentally responsible agriculture.

For the development of the project, Python was used as the main programming language and Flask for the development of the backend. SQLite was implemented as a database management system, incorporating multi-user isolation to protect and separate user information. Tailwind CSS was used for the frontend, along with interactive maps that allow you to visualize relevant information for agricultural decision-making. In addition, the NASA POWER API is integrated as a source of climate and satellite information. AGRO-ROTA's innovation consists of combining satellite information, weather monitoring and sustainable crop rotation strategies in a single digital platform.

Its global approach and its adaptation to seven agroecological zones make it possible to offer more contextualized agricultural information, turning environmental data into practical tools for decision-making.

The development focused on creating an accessible, scalable and functional digital solution, considering the integration of different data sources, information security through multi-user isolation, ease of use of the interface and adaptation to different agro-ecological conditions. The project prioritizes the use of software technologies and scientific data to drive innovation and contribute to the development of high-performance and sustainable agriculture.
dataRefs: NASA POWER: weather and solar information.
NASA GPM: information on precipitation and rain observations.
NASA SMAP: satellite information on soil moisture.
NASA Landsat: observation of the earth's surface and vegetation.
CIMMYT: information on sustainable agriculture, crop management and soil conservation.
